title: Apple’s foldable iPhone poses a $1,999 question: Who is it for?
desc: CUPERTINO, California, Sept 10 - Apple's new foldable iPhone launched on Wednesday with impressive features and a premium price tag, starting at $1,999 in the U.S. market. But some observers in the packed room at the launch event in Cupertino, California, were left questioning its appeal beyond wealthy tech enthusiasts. Read more at straitstimes.com.
